resolvedChecks.issue: Two phone title-position assertions treated focus-induced viewport scrolling as title animation.
resolvedChecks.resolution: Compare document coordinates before/after focus; no title transform or application layout change required.

resolvedChecks.issue: One phone press test selected a target while native focus scrolling was still settling.
resolvedChecks.resolution: Explicitly center the link using instant scrolling, wait for layout, then hit-test a visible point below the sticky header.

resolvedChecks.issue: A final per-asset geometry audit found the global max-width cap narrowed the new Wasabi caption SVG.
resolvedChecks.resolution: Set max-width:none on the caption background layer to preserve its original 388px source width; add that SVG to independent geometry assertions.
